title: Jazz Trio in Attic
description: Three bearded men with long curly hair play music together in a purple-walled attic with a skylight. A saxophonist sits on the left, a drummer plays in the center background, and a guitarist sits cross-legged on the right, surrounded by sheet music, effects pedals, and instrument cases.
